# sudo-mode wire fixtures

The contract for request mode `sudo` (docs/reference.md, docs/proposals/root-exec.md). The Python
broker tests (`tests/test_sudo_mode.py`) and the Rust crates (`crates/asb-proto`) both check these
files, so a second implementation of either side can be held to the same bytes. A value of
`REQUEST-ID` stands for any request id.
